title: TN India Job Collector
description: Collects recent India job postings from employer feeds, LinkedIn, and Naukri. Results from Tamil Nadu are shown first.

enableLinkedInJobs.title: Collect LinkedIn jobs
enableLinkedInJobs.description: Runs one Chennai, Tamil Nadu search with the paid LinkedIn Jobs Scraper Actor, capped by the external result limit.

enableNaukriJobs.title: Collect Naukri jobs
enableNaukriJobs.description: Runs one Chennai search with the paid Naukri Job Scraper Actor, capped by the external result limit.

externalSearchKeyword.title: External job search keyword
externalSearchKeyword.description: Optional single search term that overrides the default multi-role search query for LinkedIn and Naukri. It is also included in the final title filter. Leave empty to search using the Job keywords list.

maxExternalJobsPerSearch.title: Maximum external jobs per search
maxExternalJobsPerSearch.description: Maximum results imported from each enabled paid Store Actor. Naukri requires a minimum child input of 50 jobs; the collector still imports only this configured limit.

maxExternalChargePerSearchUsd.title: Maximum child Actor event charge per search (USD)
maxExternalChargePerSearchUsd.description: Per-run event charge cap passed to each child Actor. Naukri requires at least $0.10. At most two child runs start when both sources are enabled.

greenhouseBoards.title: Greenhouse company boards
greenhouseBoards.description: Add company board tokens as JSON. Example: [{"token":"company-token","company":"Company Name"}]

smartRecruitersCompanies.title: SmartRecruiters companies
smartRecruitersCompanies.description: Add company identifiers as JSON. Example: [{"identifier":"Freshworks","company":"Freshworks"}]

targetLocations.title: Target locations
targetLocations.description: Only jobs whose listed location contains one of these values will be collected. The default targets Tamil Nadu and Chennai.

collectAllLocations.title: Collect all locations
collectAllLocations.description: Use only for testing a source. When enabled, location filtering is skipped.

keywords.title: Job keywords
keywords.description: Default Software/IT and Data/AI roles are sent to both portal searches as an OR query and also filter final job titles. Edit or clear the list to change the roles. Search terms improve relevance but do not guarantee lower child Actor charges.

maxJobsPerBoard.title: Maximum jobs per company
maxJobsPerBoard.description: Limits recent jobs collected from each Greenhouse or SmartRecruiters company.
